english.title: Use / possess an article that had not been passed and stamped by a weight and measures inspector approved verifier
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[possessed for use]_

for trade as equipment an article, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..), to which section 11 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 applied when

(C)_[the article]_
(D)_[the equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..), in which the article was incorporated]_
(E)_[the equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..), to the operation of which the use of that article was incidental]_

had not been passed by an inspector or approved verifier as fit for such use and bore a stamp indicating that it had born so passed which remained undefaced otherwise than by reason of fair wear and tear
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 11(2) and (3) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used / had in your possession an article for trade
as equipment to which section 11 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 applied
when the article OR
the equipment in which the article was incorporated OR
the equipment to the operation of which the use of that article was incidental
had not been passed by an inspector / approved verifier
as fit for such use and bore a stamp indicating that it had been so passed
which remained undefaced otherwise than by reason of fair wear and tear

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 11(3) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that the any article in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that In England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
